fields.name: eia_id
fields.description: EIA utility number (Form 861). Stable across years; join key for other EIA data.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter state code (incl. DC). A utility serving several states has one row per state.

fields.name: name_eia
fields.description: Name exactly as reported to EIA.

fields.name: name_common
fields.description: Name customers know (e.g. "Pacific Gas & Electric" for "Pacific Gas & Electric Co."). For Texas holding companies the retail brands are added, taken from the PUCT REP directory.

fields.name: ownership
fields.description: EIA ownership class: Investor Owned, Cooperative, Municipal, Political Subdivision, State, Federal, Retail Power Marketer, Behind the Meter. Empty for Texas delivery utilities.

fields.name: type
fields.description: utility = sells energy and delivery together; retail_provider = competitive retailer (mainly Texas); behind_the_meter_solar = rooftop solar lease/PPA company; tx_delivery_utility = Texas wires company (TDU).

fields.name: residential_customers
fields.description: Residential customers (annual average) for bundled or retail service.

fields.name: avg_cents_per_kwh
fields.description: Residential revenue divided by residential sales, in cents per kWh. All-in average, including fixed charges.

fields.name: avg_kwh_per_month
fields.description: Residential sales per customer per month, in kWh.

fields.name: avg_bill_usd_per_month
fields.description: Residential revenue per customer per month, in US dollars.

fields.name: delivery_only_customers
fields.description: Customers that buy only delivery from this utility (energy from a competitive supplier). Empty where not reported.

fields.name: delivery_cents_per_kwh
fields.description: Delivery revenue divided by delivery sales for those customers, in cents per kWh.

fields.name: comparable
fields.description: no = should not be ranked against utilities: solar lease/PPA companies, and Texas retail providers below 12 cents/kWh whose reported revenue does not cover a full bill.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: Page on electricbillmath.com with the explanation for this utility. Empty for small utilities without a page.
